name: paperclip-agent-control-mcp
description: Local stdio MCP server for Paperclip projects, workspaces, agents, tasks and runs

scripts.check: node --check paperclip-mcp.mjs && node --check paperclip-mcp-call.mjs && node --check test/bridge.test.mjs && node --check test/bulk.test.mjs && node --check test/project_agent_mcp.test.mjs
